pageDescription: Upload a zip of folders and files into a course in one go.

multi.heading: One zip, many {{term}}
multi.description: Name each top-level folder after a {{term}}. The content inside is matched to that {{term}}'s existing structure automatically — you'll review everything before anything is uploaded.

single.heading: Where should this content go?
single.description: Pick the {{term}} (and batch) this zip belongs to. The folder structure inside the zip becomes the {{term}} structure.

pickersEmptyState: Select a {{course}}, {{session}} and {{level}} to start uploading.
